overview.description: The Defiance China Memory ETF (CRAM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the BITA China Memory index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of companies listed on mainland China and Hong Kong, that are principally engaged in the memory and storage semiconductor value chain. CRAM was launched on Sep 9, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
